facts.note: In the United Kingdom, nutrias were introduced to East Anglia, for fur, in 1929; many escaped and damaged the drainage works, and a concerted programme by MAFF eradicated them by 1989.

facts.note: The state has adopted an eradication campaign based on the successful effort in the Chesapeake Bay, including strategies such as the "Judas nutria" (in which individualized nutrias are caught, sterilized, fitted with radio collars, and released, whereupon they can be tracked by hunters as they return to their colonies)
